title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established international business based in Aylesbury.
Reporting to the number one of Finance , you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, with exposure across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, banking and month-end.
This is a varied, hands-on position where no two days will be exactly the same.
Your new role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and payments
- Reconciling supplier statements and intercompany accounts
- Managing supplier queries and maintaining accurate account records
- Processing expenses and supporting accruals and prepayments
- Issuing customer statements and following up outstanding balances
- Resolving customer payment and pricing queries
- Raising invoices and credit notes
- Completing monthly bank reconciliations
- Reconciling retail sales, card payments, settlements and associated fees
- Supporting month-end reporting and audit requirements
- Assisting the Finance Manager with ad hoc projects and process improvements

What you'll need to succeed
You'll be an experienced finance professional with a strong eye for detail, a methodical approach and a genuine problem-solving mindset.
Ideally, you'll have worked in a similar hands-on finance role, with the confidence to investigate discrepancies, resolve complex queries and see issues through to completion.You'll ideally bring:
- Experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and account reconciliations
- Experience investigating and resolving complex financial queries
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- A proactive, analytical and problem-solving approach
- Good Excel skills and previous experience using accounting software
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a wider team

An AAT qualification or equivalent would be beneficial but is not essential.
You'll also have an interest in developing your systems knowledge and embracing new technology, including the appropriate use of AI tools to support financial processes and improve efficiency.
What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity if you're looking for a role that offers more variety and responsibility than a traditional transactional finance position.You'll gain exposure across several areas of the finance function while working closely with the Finance Manager within an established international business.The package includes:
- £35,000-£38,000 depending on experience
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Hybrid working two days per week from home
- Flexible working around standard hours of 9am-5pm

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or contact us directly for further information.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

High Wycombe c£35,000 Accountancy Practice Part-Qualified Accountant Ideally

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Bookkeeper to join a well-established and growing accountancy practice based in High Wycombe.

This is a varied role within an Outsourced Accounting Services environment, supporting a portfolio of clients with their day-to-day bookkeeping and wider accounting requirements.

We are looking for someone who enjoys more than simply processing transactions. You will have the opportunity to work directly with clients, prepare information for management accounts, deal with queries and take ownership of your workload.

Ideally, you will be part-qualified or studying towards an accountancy qualification, although strong bookkeeping experience within an accountancy practice will also be considered.

1) The Role

Working as part of the Outsourced Accounting Services team, you will provide bookkeeping support to a range of external clients, working across different businesses and accounting systems.

The role will include:
- Posting sales, purchase, bank and journal entries accurately and efficiently.
- Preparing and reconciling control accounts and producing information required for management accounts.
- Writing up clients' cashbooks using the relevant accounting software.
- Carrying out bookkeeping for clients both remotely and, where required, at client premises.
- Preparing sensible analysis, summaries and basic working papers.
- Reviewing bookkeeping completed by other members of the team and ensuring information is accurate and complete.
- Liaising directly with clients to answer queries, resolve bookkeeping issues and help finalise jobs.
- Supporting the wider team with client accounting and outsourced finance work.
- Using cloud-based bookkeeping systems such as Xero, Sage and QuickBooks.
- Working with Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook as part of your day-to-day role.

It is a role that offers genuine variety. You will work with different clients, different businesses and different accounting requirements rather than being restricted to one set of accounts.

You will also be trusted to manage your own workload, with the expectation that you can work independently while knowing when to ask for support.

2) About You

You will ideally have previous bookkeeping experience within an accountancy practice, although applications from strong industry-based bookkeepers with relevant experience will also be considered.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are:
- Experienced in bookkeeping and comfortable dealing with sales, purchases, banking and journals.
- Confident with reconciliations and producing accurate financial information.
- Familiar with cloud accounting software, particularly Xero, Sage and/or QuickBooks.
- Ideally AAT qualified, part-qualified ACA/ACCA/CIMA, or actively studying towards an accountancy qualification.
- Comfortable working across a portfolio of clients rather than concentrating on a single business.
- Able to communicate confidently and professionally with clients.
- Highly organised, with good attention to detail.
- IT literate, including a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Able to work independently and take responsibility for getting jobs completed.
- Commercially aware and able to understand the bigger picture behind the numbers.
- Someone who takes pride in producing accurate work and providing a good service to clients.

Most importantly, you will be someone who enjoys working in a professional accountancy environment and wants to continue developing your accounting career.

3) The Offer

In return, you can expect a salary of around £35,000, depending on experience and qualifications, together with the opportunity to develop your career within an established accountancy practice.

This is a particularly good opportunity for someone who has built a solid bookkeeping background and now wants to take the next step towards a broader accounting role.

If you are already studying towards AAT, ACCA, ACA or CIMA, the role could provide excellent practical experience alongside your studies.

You will gain exposure to a variety of clients and accounting situations, develop your technical bookkeeping and accounting skills, and work within a team where there is scope to take on additional responsibility as your experience grows.

The variety of client work also means that no two days are necessarily the same. If you enjoy working with businesses, dealing with people and getting under the skin of the numbers, this could be an excellent next move.

4) Apply Now

If you are an experienced Bookkeeper, ideally with accountancy practice experience and a desire to progress your career, we would like to hear from you.

If this particular role isn't quite right but you are looking for a Bookkeeper, Accounts Assistant, Assistant Accountant or Part-Qualified Accountant position in the High Wycombe, Wycombe, Marlow, Beaconsfield or wider Buckinghamshire area, please get in touch.

RD Financial Recruitment specialises in recruiting finance professionals from Bookkeepers through to Finance Directors, and we take the time to understand what you are looking for before introducing you to an opportunity.

title: Corporate Credit Controller
description:
Corporate Credit Controller - permanent
£30,000 - £32,000 (depending on experience)
Hybrid working - 2 days in the office, 3 at home

High Wycombe location (near public transport routes and free parking and modern offices)

UK residents only. We cannot assist with overseas applications or VISA assistance.

Gleeson Recruitment Group are working very closely with one of the most well-established, multi-site clients in the UK, who have over 250 sites throughout the UK. Their centralised finance function sits in very modern offices in Buckinghamshire and they require a Corporate Credit Controller, to join their friendly, team-spirited team.

My client can offer training on their in-house systems, to the successful Corporate Credit Controller, but this role is ideally geared to those with existing credit control experience, looking after Corporate accounts. You ideally will have held similar roles within a team environment previously, and if you are able to hit the ground running with limited training, then this would be preferred.

Based in their central collections team in their modern High Wycombe Offices, the Credit Controller will be responsible for your own portfolio of customer accounts of around 200-300 live accounts, of a recently acquired business, and you will undertake the following duties, whilst working in an experienced team, reporting to the Credit Supervisor:
- To pro-actively chase an assigned portfolio to ensure payment to terms and maximise collections in order to achieve monthly and quarterly targets. This will mainly be email chasing of Corporate Accounts, with most clients working from home

-Communicate with customers on a daily basis, via email and call to ensure prompt payment of outstanding invoices and maximise cash collected
- Focus on maintaining and developing excellent relationships with customers and resolving any queries accordingly in an efficient and effective manner
- Daily use of customer portals to ensure all overdue accounts are fully tracked with all notes/cash received
- Resolving queries, as many of the customers are on Direct Debit so many queries need to be handled throughout the month
- Raise credit notes and re-issue invoices as and when required
- Maintain detailed notes on all accounts, and up-date all relevant systems with the status of all outstanding invoices

This is a challenging, fast-paced Corporate Credit Controller position, and requires the individual to be extremely team-focused, and be able to multi-task with ease, and work effectively with all internal colleagues, account managers, sales staff and admin staff at all times. The ability to work under pressure is essential.

Please contact me for further information of this superb Corporate Credit Controller opportunity, where my client can offer superb, modern offices, free parking and a great working environment. You will be working from home 3 days a week and in the office 2 days per week, also with long term career opportunities available also.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Location: Milton Keynes
Salary: £30,000
Working Pattern: Hybrid

Reed Accountancy are delighted to be supporting a well-established and growing organisation in their search for a Credit Controller to join their finance team based in Milton Keynes.

About the Job

As Credit Controller, you will take ownership of a varied and busy ledger, ensuring outstanding invoices are collected efficiently while maintaining positive relationships with customers. Working closely with both internal departments and external clients, you will be responsible for managing the collection process from start to finish, resolving payment queries, assessing credit risk, and helping to minimise bad debt exposure. This role would suit someone who enjoys a proactive approach to credit management and is confident communicating with customers at all levels.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts and ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices.
- Chasing overdue debts by telephone and email while maintaining professional customer relationships.
- Monitoring aged debt reports and taking appropriate action to reduce overdue balances.
- Investigating and resolving invoice, billing and payment disputes efficiently.
- Reviewing and processing credit applications.
- Assessing customer creditworthiness and monitoring credit limits.
- Negotiating payment plans and settlements where appropriate.
- Working closely with sales, operations and finance teams to resolve account queries.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and collection notes.
- Supporting month-end reporting and wider credit control activities.
- Assisting with credit risk management and helping to minimise potential bad debt.

About You

The successful candidate will be an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys building strong relationships and working in a fast-moving environment. You will be a confident communicator with excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. You will take pride in delivering a high standard of customer service while remaining focused on achieving collection targets and improving cash flow. Whether you are looking to take the next step in your Credit Control career or are seeking a new challenge within an ambitious organisation, this opportunity offers excellent long-term potential.

What You Need to Succeed

To be considered for this opportunity, you should possess:
- Previous experience within a Credit Control or Accounts Receivable environment.
- Experience managing a high-volume ledger.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities.
- The confidence to challenge and influence customers professionally.
- A proactive and solutions-focused mindset.
- Strong systems experience and good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- The ability to build effective relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
- Experience using NetSuite would be highly advantageous, although candidates with strong Credit Control experience gained on other systems are also encouraged to apply.

Next Steps

Apply today or contact Reed Accountancy for a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity. Due to the expected level of interest, suitable applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
